```{r}
long_data_sense <- read.csv2("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/04_output/expression_matrix_output/ddm16909_vs_wt6909_selected_raw_fcmorethan1padjless005_batch_no_corr_filtered_ddm1ct_10readstotal_sene_long_data.csv")

long_data_anti_sense <- read.csv2("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/04_output/expression_matrix_output/ddm16909_vs_wt6909_selected_raw_fcmorethan1padjless005_batch_no_corr_filtered_ddm1ct_10readstotal_anti_sense_long_data.csv")
sequencing_date <- read.csv2("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/10_metadata/ddm1_crosses_metadata_2repl_filtered_num_reads_mapping_rate_filtered_outliers_by_pca.txt", header=T, sep=",") %>% select(Sample_id,Sequencing_date)

## Combine data
library(dplyr)
# Remove _AS suffix 
long_data_anti_sense <- long_data_anti_sense %>%
  mutate(TE = gsub("_AS$", "", TE))
# TEs unique to each
sense_only_TEs <- setdiff(long_data_sense$TE, long_data_anti_sense$TE)
anti_only_TEs  <- setdiff(long_data_anti_sense$TE, long_data_sense$TE)
# Filter and combine
long_data_combined <- bind_rows(
  long_data_sense %>% filter(TE %in% sense_only_TEs),
  long_data_anti_sense %>% filter(TE %in% anti_only_TEs)
)
```

Cluster log2 transposon expression

```{r}
te_annotation <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/ref_genome/TAIR10_Transposable_Elements.txt", header=T)
```

```{r}
library(pheatmap)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
# Prepare matrix with TEs as rows, accessions as columns
heatmap_data_log2 <- long_data_combined %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, TE, expression_value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample_id, values_from = expression_value) %>%  # Switch here
  column_to_rownames("TE") %>%
  as.matrix()

heatmap_data_log2_family <- left_join(long_data_combined,te_annotation, by=c("TE"="Transposon_Name"))

# Prepare row annotation (TE superfamily)
te_annotation <- heatmap_data_log2_family %>%
  distinct(TE, Transposon_Super_Family) %>%
  arrange(TE)
# Row annotation. Define colors 
superfamily_colors <- c(
  "#E41A1C",  
  "#377EB8",  
  "#4DAF4A", 
  "#984EA3",  
  "#FF7F00",  
  "#FFFF33",  
  "#A65628", 
  "#F781BF",  
  "#999999",  
  "#66C2A5", 
  "#5C5470", 
  "#0AC4E0"
)

# Get unique superfamilies
unique_superfamilies <- unique(te_annotation$Transposon_Super_Family)

# Create named color vector
superfamily_col <- setNames(superfamily_colors[1:length(unique_superfamilies)], 
                            unique_superfamilies)

# Row annotation with custom colors
row_ha <- rowAnnotation(
  Superfamily = te_annotation$Transposon_Super_Family,
  col = list(Superfamily = superfamily_col)
)


# Plot
ht <- Heatmap(log2(heatmap_data_log2+1),
        name = "log2 expression",
        right_annotation = row_ha,
        cluster_rows = TRUE,
        cluster_columns = TRUE,
        show_row_names = FALSE,
        show_column_names = FALSE,
        row_km = 3,
        row_km_repeats = 1000,
        column_km_repeats = 1000,
        column_km = 2,
        row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
        column_title = "TE expression log2 scaled",
        row_title = "TEs")

draw(ht)

# Extract TE clusters
ht_draw <- draw(ht)
row_clusters <- row_order(ht_draw)
```

Create TE list attributed to the different clusters

```{r}
# Get cluster assignment for TEs
te_cluster_assignment <- data.frame(
  TE = rownames(heatmap_data_log2),
  cluster = rep(1:3, times = sapply(row_clusters, length))[order(unlist(row_clusters))]
)
write.csv2(te_cluster_assignment,"/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/04_output/cluters_te_expression.csv", quote = F, row.names = F)
```
